watched #Liger : Disaster!!!! Poori & Devarakonda kalisi Karan Johar gadi ni De…De..De…Debesesaru!!

Everyone knows that Puri is very weak with his stories and its only his kickass characterisations and their kickass dialogues which give that much needed kick to audience!!! and much to my dismay thats exactly what missing in this movie….You expect some ultimate high octane dialogues from Puri’s hero, but when the hero stammers there is no scope for him to deliver basic stuff forget about Puri’s trade mark dialogues 😞

In the quest to go Pan India….Puri just ditched his strength which has been his only saving grace all these years!!!

Ananya Pandey was at her annoying best…Ramya Krishna was the only saving grace

Being a huge fan of Puri Jaganadh’s hard hitting dialogues….I was very keen to see how Liger fares especially in the times where any movie with content is being a Blockbuster and Normal Masala movies being outrightly rejected!!! and till #ismartShankar Puri was struck in the same old formula and this movie being made on grand pan indian scale was curious how things would turn out….and it Puri made it worse by sticking to his old rotten masala format minus his trademark style dialogues
